comments.author: Visitor
comments.body:
Marbled Beef Steak
Fatigue recovery/Vigour +70 (fleet food)

It is possible to produce these at San Francisco's tavern with a 19th Century Adept of Ages title and requires Cooking R12. The ingredients are: 2 Beef, 1 Brandy, 2 Salt. It is part of the Pacific Speciality Dishes Memorial Album.

comments.author: EarlGrey
comments.body: Also can be obtained from Mysterious Bonanza Box (No.8)
